title: Angular Developer- Realocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture ;
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation projects , from requirements analysis to deployment and support;
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability in cloud-based environments;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and best practices;
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, testing, and monitoring tools;
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the modernization of the technology stack.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong expertise in Angular (Components, Services, RxJS, Observables, NgRx or equivalent state management tools).

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori (freestile)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno ou Senior com forte atuação em Fiori/UI5 e Webdynpro ABAP para desenvolvimento de novas soluções e evolutivos em ambiente SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.
  • Importante dominar FIori (freestile)
  • Implementar programas, APIs e objetos ABAP (BAPIs, BADIs, user-exits/enhancements) necessários para suportar novas soluções Fiori e Webdynpro.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno, com foco em desenvolvimento (novos projetos e evolutivos), e não apenas suporte/sustentação.
  • Experiência prática com SAP Fiori/UI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, SAPUI5) e consumo/criação de serviços OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações Webdynpro ABAP (criação e evolução de componentes, views e controllers).
  • Vaga CLT


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Front End Engineer
  • Location: Remote (Brazil)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web interfaces using ReactJS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in UI development
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless performance across devices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues throughout development lifecycle

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with ReactJS :
  • Mid-Level: 3–4 years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Senior: 5+ years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5, CSS3, and related front-end tools
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and agile development methodologies
  • Must currently be actively working with ReactJS technologies

title: Assistant Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remoto

Na Blue Dot BPO, conectamos talentos LATAM a equipes executivas de alta performance em empresas norte-americanas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Recruiter Assistant com excelente comunicação em inglês, organização e proatividade para atuar em operações de recrutamento de alto volume. A posição é totalmente remota, voltada ao mercado dos EUA, com exposição diária a times globais e trilha clara de crescimento para quem deseja construir carreira em recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$3.500 reais.
  • 100% remoto, atuando diretamente com equipes de recrutamento dos Estados Unidos.
  • Turno de segunda a sexta, das 13h às 22h BRT .
  • Oportunidade de crescimento acelerado (carreira em recrutamento executivo, liderança ou gestão).
  • Networking internacional + ambiente multicultural.
  • Treinamento remunerado e acompanhamento estruturado.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de recrutamento do cliente (EUA) na busca e pré-qualificação de candidatos.
  • Realizar triagens iniciais via chamadas telefônicas, e-mail e mensagens.
  • Manter bases de dados atualizadas (job boards e ATS).
  • Redigir e atualizar job descriptions e perfis de vaga.
  • Mapear talentos em job boards e bancos de currículos.
  • Gerenciar agendas e apoiar o fluxo de comunicação entre candidatos e recrutadores.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à operação e organização do time de recrutamento.


O que buscamos

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação escrita e falada obrigatória.
  • Organização, foco e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Perfil detalhista, proativo e orientado a entregas.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento ou talent acquisition.
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics ou outros ATS.
  • Vivência com operações de alto volume e prazos desafiadores.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Dois monitores | Processador i5/i7 (ou equivalente) | 12GB+ RAM .
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset com microfone e ambiente silencioso.


Construa sua carreira em recrutamento!


Se você quer trabalhar diretamente com equipes dos EUA, adquirir experiência relevante e evoluir rapidamente, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

description:
We are currently searching for a Portuguese speaking Solution Architect/Developer to work with our biggest customer remotely in Brazil.


In this role you will leverage your technical expertise in Microsoft Teams and Viva to deliver proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in Brazil.

  • Experience in customer and stakeholder management

We look forward to receiving your applications.


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager

Duration: Fulltime with CriticalRiver

Location: Brazil/Costa Rica

Need to support PST timings

Job Profile:

  • Manage delivery for our key customers across all the technological tracks
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Ensure regular updates to customer stake holders sent through WSRs
  • Conduct MBRs and QBRs
  • Achieve high customer delight


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget by working with technology teams.
  • Work closely with customer stake holders and ensure the project scope is well understood and documented as per the defined standards
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Work with PMO and ensure quality control procedures to ensure high standards in the delivery.
  • Act as a delivery point of contact for Customer, Understanding the Customer, managing expectations and ensuring highest customer satisfaction.
  • Service/Project Review meetings with Customer and Management
  • Adopt customer specific processes and methodologies.
  • Proactively Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks effectively.
  • Ensure that the project teams meet SLAs and avoid service credits / penalties.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Utilize effective conflict resolution and negotiation tactics to maintain high-level performance within service teams.
  • Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs as performance metrics for team members.
  • Support hiring the right resources for various tracks as the roles get identified by working with the TAG teams
  • Ensure SOWs are signed and Invoices cleared on-time by working with finance teams and the customer stakeholders
  • Continuously work with individual members in the project teams and ensure their contributions are made visible to customer in terms of activities/stories/Jira Tickets as applicable on a weekly basis and obtain continuous feedback on the performance of the teams and course correct as needed appropriately.
  • Work with customer stake holders, identify the opportunities, proactively create proposals with efforts, solutioning and financials


Skills:

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Proven experience in software development project management, must have worked with onshore/Nearshore/offshore model. Open to be flexible to be able to speak to teams in different time zones.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, thought leadership skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Familiarity with various project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, ITIL).
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to manage complex project challenges

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;

  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;

  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;

  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Software Engineer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs using Apigee (preferred), KrakenD, or AWS API Gateway.
  • Implement scalable and secure API architectures using REST, gRPC, and GraphQL.
  • Develop backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and frontend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript with React or Angular.
  • Work with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP for deployment, scaling, and monitoring.
  • Utilize CI/CD pipelines (ADO Pipelines), GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes to manage code, build processes, and deployments.
  • Write robust unit, integration, and automated tests using tools such as Cucumber and Mockito.
  • Contribute to cross-organization API standards, documentation, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Agile/Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall professional experience.
  • Java (Spring Boot):
  • API Development:
  • API Management (Apigee/KrakenD/AWS Gateway): 3 years
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP):
  • JavaScript/TypeScript:
  • React/Angular:
  • Strong understanding of API protocols and architectural patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Proficiency with CI/CD, GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience writing automated tests (Cucumber, Mockito).
  • Ability to write clear documentation and contribute to API governance efforts.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Decskill was founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company and their main mission is to delivery value through the knowledge. We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.


DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:


• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.


Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.


We are looking for a Senior Java Developer for a remote project in Brazil.


Key requirements :


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java development and proficiency in the latest editions of Java, including expertise in Spring Boot.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Microservices architecture, and design patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in frontend technologies like React.js or Angular is a strong plus.
  • Experience in NodeJs and PostgreSQL database is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of security best practices related to APIs and data privacy.
  • Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and a commitment to driving Agile practices within the team.
  • Comfortable with DevOps practices involving configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, Gitflow, IaC, deployment patterns among others.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
  • Proficiency in English is a must.


Role and Key Accountabilities:


  • Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of the applications.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to ensure alignment with business requirements and meet delivery timelines.
  • Prioritize and facilitate the early resolution of client issues, ensuring adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Conduct code reviews, contribute to critical feature designs, and ensure the overall quality of the team's deliverables.
  • Flag technical debt and areas of improvements, making sure they are properly documented and taken into account when defining priorities.
  • Implement a robust documentation system for knowledge base, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and communication in software development activities.
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to these problems.
  • Follow Agile Scrum development process for application development.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference “DA/SJD” .


Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: SRE - brazil
description:
Decskill, founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company, places paramount importance on its greatest asset: its people. Our main mission is to deliver value through knowledge and talent, and we achieve this by fostering a culture of excellence and investing in the development and well-being of our people. With over 600 dedicated professionals and offices in Lisbon, Porto, Madrid, and Luxembourg, Decskill operates across three core areas:


  • Decskill Talent: We believe that our people are key to our success. Through Decskill Talent, we empower our team to embrace the digital transformation challenges of our clients. We collaborate with clients to drive innovation, ensuring project success and business growth.


  • Decskill Boost: Equipping our team with the latest tools and methodologies, we optimize Time-to-Market and deliver innovative solutions exceeding client expectations.


  • Decskill Connect: Our team collaborates closely with clients to implement and manage IT infrastructures that generate long-term value.


At Decskill, we believe that by nurturing and empowering our people to confront the challenges of digital transformation, we create value not only for our clients but also for our entire ecosystem, fostering a digital community dedicated to growth and progress.


We are looking for an SRE to join us on a remote project in Brasil.


Responsabilities:

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and managers to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maximize the capabilities of our Azure platform for business applications.
  • Continuously evolve and enhance our identity management systems.
  • Prioritize the observability of our Azure environments.
  • Maintain cost efficiency and FinOps control of the platform.
  • Implement SRE and DevOps practices with a focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and implement new features to foster a CI/CD mindset, optimizing the software development lifecycle from development to production.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents, ensuring they do not recur.
  • Implement code review and testing mechanisms to continuously improve quality.
  • Ensure robust security practices are integrated into all aspects of the infrastructure and identity management systems.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on Azure.
  • Apply best practices for security, compliance, and operational efficiency across all systems.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Azure and its ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with identity management technologies, particularly Azure Active Directory and EntraID.
  • Solid understanding of observability best practices, particularly in Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in using code management tools and repositories.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, particularly with Terraform.
  • Strong autonomy and critical thinking skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, listening, and speaking), a collaborative mindset, and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).


Additional/Preferable Skills

  • Proficiency in using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with security frameworks and best practices in cloud environments.
  • Certified Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference DA/SRE

title: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuará como Analista de Suporte no Service Desk para atendimento de clientes globais em inglês no modelo Follow The Sun (FTS).
  • Escala 12x36 (9h as 21h).


O que esperamos de você:

Indispensável:

  • Experiência prévia em Service Desk / Suporte Técnico N1.
  • Conhecimento em: Windows 10/11, contas de usuário, permissões e troubleshooting básico, Active Directory (reset de senha, desbloqueio, grupos).
  • Pacote Office / M365 (Ex: Configuração de Outlook e etc).
  • VPN, redes básicas e conectividade.
  • Hardware e periféricos.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ticket (preferencialmente ServiceNow).
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação com equipes globais).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com ambiente global 24x7 / FTS.
  • Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.
  • Experiência em suporte a múltiplos clientes (MSP).
  • Espanhol Intermediário


Formação Obrigatória:

Cursando Graduação na área de TI, Graduado ou Ensino Médio Técnico (TI) completo.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuará como Analista de Suporte no Service Desk para atendimento de clientes globais em inglês no modelo Follow The Sun (FTS).
  • Escala 12x36 (9h as 21h).


O que esperamos de você:

Indispensável:

  • Experiência prévia em Service Desk / Suporte Técnico N1.
  • Conhecimento em: Windows 10/11, contas de usuário, permissões e troubleshooting básico, Active Directory (reset de senha, desbloqueio, grupos).
  • Pacote Office / M365 (Ex: Configuração de Outlook e etc).
  • VPN, redes básicas e conectividade.
  • Hardware e periféricos.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ticket (preferencialmente ServiceNow).
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação com equipes globais).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com ambiente global 24x7 / FTS.
  • Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.
  • Experiência em suporte a múltiplos clientes (MSP).
  • Espanhol Intermediário


Formação Obrigatória:

Cursando Graduação na área de TI, Graduado ou Ensino Médio Técnico (TI) completo.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Salesforce Developer with Vlocity (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Responsibilities:

· Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

· Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

· Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

· Manage offshore team and support existing Salesforce applications, including troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance tuning.

· Provide technical leadership to junior developers, including planning, assigning, and reviewing their tasks, to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize tickets based on urgency, impact, and business value.

· Estimate effort and timelines for user stories and tasks to support effective sprint planning.

· Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

· Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

· Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

· Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

· Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.


Qualifications:

· Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

· Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

· Strong background in Salesforce Vlocity development, particularly with EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and IPs.

· Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

· Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

· Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

· Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for leading projects and delivering exceptional solutions, we encourage you to apply and join our innovative team.



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno
description:
Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto


Informações adicionais


Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:


⏱Horários Flexíveis

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.
